# Generate all reasonable column partitions of [0,1,2,3] into 3 groups
def get_col_partitions(n_cols, n_groups):
    # Generate partitions using recursion/backtracking
    partitions = []
    
    def backtrack(start, current_partition, remaining):
        if len(current_partition) == n_groups - 1:
            # Last group gets everything remaining
            partitions.append([*current_partition, list(remaining)])
            return
        
        for end in range(start+1, start+len(remaining)+1):
            next_group = set(range(start, end))
            backtrack(end, [*current_partition, list(next_group)], set(range(end, n_cols)))
    
    backtrack(0, [], set(range(n_cols)))
    return partitions
